subject: Renewal & Expansion MAP launch — stakeholder intros, goals, and timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.m@brightwavehealth.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & Expansion MAP — launch & stakeholder intros

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the partnership — BrightWave is starting our renewal discussion and we want to build a practical mutual action plan that covers both the renewal and the expansion we discussed at the exec sync. High-level context below so we can align stakeholders and timelines.

Summary:
- Current contract renewal: Mar 31, 2026 (annual)
- Expansion interest: add advanced embeddings and an additional dedicated GPU pool for our predictive analytics workloads (targeting +25% seat usage)
- Primary drivers: latency during peak training windows, and predictable throughput for nightly ingestion jobs

Who I’m looping in: Asha (procurement), Ethan (platform lead). They’ll want a clearer timeline and a short list of deliverables we can track.

Attachments: BrightWave_usage_Oct2025.pdf (usage trends + spikes)

As next steps: can your team propose an initial MAP with owners, milestones, and a suggested evaluation plan? Ideally we start a two-month evaluation in Jan to validate the dedicated pool sizing and the embeddings latency before we finalize commercial terms.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Data Platforms
BrightWave Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.m@brightwavehealth.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightwavehealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion MAP — launch & stakeholder intros

Jordan — really appreciate the clear context and the attachment. Attaching a first-draft MAP (RW_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out proposed milestones, owners, and an evaluation plan that fits the Jan start you suggested. High level below, plus immediate asks so we can lock owners.

High-level MAP (draft):
- Week 0 (Jan 5) — MAP kickoff: confirm owners, success metrics, and test data sets (owner: Vanessa)
- Week 1–4 — Evaluation phase A: embeddings latency benchmark + dedicated pool baseline (owner: Marcus)
- Week 5–8 — Evaluation phase B: throughput validation under production load + cost assessment (owner: Sergio)
- Week 9 — Review & decision deck for execs (owner: Vanessa)

Success metrics (proposed):
- 95th percentile embeddings latency <= 120ms for 512-token payloads
- Nightly ingestion job throughput within 12% of baseline at 2x concurrency
- Cost per 1k tokens change within +/-15% of current after batching and quantization suggestions

Immediate asks for your team (please reply inline):
1) Confirm Asha and Ethan as procurement and platform leads respectively (we need a procurement timeline)
2) Share 2–3 representative prompt/embedding samples and an S3 location or dataset we can use for controlled runs
3) Any blackout dates in Jan–Feb where you cannot run tests?

Attachments: RW_MAP_v1.xlsx — contains milestone dates, the evaluation checklist, and a simple tracker.

I’ll let Sergio and Marcus add sizing and the initial upsell roadmap (high level) in a follow-up. If this looks good, suggest a 30-minute kickoff on Jan 6 — I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm owners.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Lead — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

---

Attachment: RW_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: milestones | owners | success criteria)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightwavehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion MAP — launch & stakeholder intros

Thanks Vanessa — adding a few concrete items on the expansion/upsell side and a realistic commercial timeline so procurement has something to react to.

Proposed expansion package (high level):
- Dedicated pool: 2 x A100 equiv nodes (reserved) + 20% burst capacity
- Advanced embeddings add-on: volume pricing tier at 30% discount after 50M tokens/month
- Optimize bundle: initial quantization pass + automatic kv-prefix caching enabled for eligible routes

Commercial timeline (recommended):
- Jan 06: MAP kickoff (confirm owners)
- Jan 06–Feb 28: Evaluation (technical) — no charge for eval run hours up to 1k GPU hours; overage at consumption rates
- Mar 01–Mar 14: Commercial review and SOW finalization
- Mar 15–Mar 31: Contract signatures & change freeze window for migration

Deliverables during evaluation:
- Weekly usage and latency snapshot (Marcus)
- Interim cost projection report after Phase A (Marcus + Finance)
- Final decision packet (Vanessa)

Procurement notes for Asha: we can provide a draft SOW and a standard SLA addendum. If you have an internal PO process or preferred contract flow (DocuSign vs signed PDF), tell us and we’ll align.

Related links: HubSpot deal RW-8742 and a draft DocuSign link I’ll update once Marcus confirms the node sizing.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a short tech sync between Marcus and Ethan to size test jobs; Marcus, can you be available early next week?

— Sergio
Sr. Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

We’re aligned on the proposed Jan 6 kickoff and the evaluation windows. Asha, I’ll let you coordinate any procurement constraints — our legal prefers DocuSign but procurement can accept signed PDFs if needed.
